programs.description: A carefree boy, who is next in line to take over a textile business, goes astray after his love interest leaves him. Soon, he decides to disown his ancestral wealth and become self-reliant.
Tushar, an engineer, comes back to his village after studying in the USA. He does not believe in ghosts but experiences strange and paranormal events in his ancestral home.
Arundhati selflessly dedicates her life to her family, but when she realizes her sacrifices are unappreciated, she embarks on a journey of self-discovery to reclaim her identity and independence.

Shrikant, a shrewd businessman, decides to celebrate his birthday with his family. However, everything turns into a mess when he randomly starts shouting at everyone for no reason.
